name: resumekit
idea: ResumeKit is a free, browser-only resume builder with live preview, Classic and Modern templates, and one-click PDF export — no signup required, no data ever leaves the device, built for job seekers who want a professional resume in minutes.
why_trending: 'Free resume builder' is one of the highest-volume search queries in the career tools category (estimated 500K+ monthly US searches). The job market volatility throughout 2025-2026 has driven a surge in resume-building activity; tools like Zety, Resume.io, and Canva all monetize this demand at $15-40/month, leaving a massive audience searching for a genuinely free, no-sign-up alternative. A January 2026 Hacker News post about 1,300 free client-side calculators went viral, confirming strong appetite for ad-free browser tools in this category.
why_profitable: Monetizes via Google AdSense targeting high-intent job-seeker traffic (CPMs $6-12 for career/jobs audience). A future 'Pro' tier ($7 one-time) unlocks additional templates, custom accent colors, and multi-page export. Affiliate partnerships with LinkedIn Premium and resume-review services add passive revenue. Comparable tools (Zety, Resume.io) convert 3-8% of free users to paid at $15-40/month.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS with zero backend — jsPDF (loaded from unpkg CDN) generates the PDF entirely client-side. LocalStorage persists resume data across sessions with no database. The entire app is a single index.html file deployable to GitHub Pages, Netlify, or any static host in under a minute. No build step, no npm, no auth.
